# ARCH-15: internal_error is for the impossible, not the unexpected

- `INTERNAL_ERROR` marks a state the code believes cannot happen - "land now, do not fly again until the bug is fixed" (peterbarker, [#24196](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/pull/24196)) - so it reaches the logs and watchdog dumps without asserts. If a sensor, a GCS or a parameter can cause the condition, it is input handling, not an internal error. Harmless misuse is not raised either, and a non-critical fault at startup is recorded rather than leaving the board unbootable.

Confirmed 2026-10-16. Part of the root playbook, under [Architectural Principles](../claude/CLAUDE.md#architectural-principles). [All architectural rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
